run_pulsar_scene_optimization: run the pulsar scene optimization example that renders random spheres and optimizes them against a reference image
create_SceneModel: create a SceneModel with random sphere positions, colors, and radii parameterized as learnable PyTorch parameters
run_renderer_forward: run the pulsar renderer forward pass with sphere positions, colors, radii, and camera parameters to render a scene
optimize_scene_with_SGD: optimize a scene model using SGD with per-parameter learning rates for colors, radii, and positions
review_cli_optimization_loop: review the cli optimization loop that computes MSE loss, backpropagates, and prunes low-radius or white-colored points
